'''Rachari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] when the Empire provoken poisonous local fauna into attacking Republic forces. Rachari was wounded and suffered from poisoning, though he was eventually treated by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kayen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ensign Rachari appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis during the mission "Emergent Medicine."<ref name="SWTOR" />
